title: Cash refund at 12 days with the current policy retrieved before acting
description: A customer at 12 days requests a cash refund. The agent retrieves the current policy via search_docs before issuing the refund. Positive control proving the verifier does not overblock a run that retrieves properly.
goal: Resolve the customer's request in compliance with the current refund policy, grounded in a retrieved policy doc.
expected_behavior: Retrieve the current policy via search_docs before deciding
Confirm the current policy doc appears in the retrieval results
Issue the cash refund allowed within 30 days
forbidden_actions: issuing the refund without first calling search_docs
acting on a search_docs result that never surfaced the current policy doc
required_evidence: current policy doc present in the retrieval results

metadata.user_message: Hi, I signed up for the Team Monthly plan about two weeks ago and would like a refund. — Nina Volkov
